note: This summary highlights the meeting's key discussions and decisions, with direct quotes and timestamps for verification — it is not a substitute for watching the full meeting. Four of seven regular members were present (a quorum); no student representative attended. A brief special meeting for three staffing nominations; every vote passed unanimously. Summarization necessarily condenses and selects; for complete context, nuance, and anything not covered, watch the full video at the link above. (Produced by: WestbrookCurrents.com)

blocks.x: Dr. Lancia asked to add item 8.1.3, an occupational therapist nomination for Sacarappa School.
Approved 4–0, moved by Erin Cavallaro, seconded by Noreen Poitras.
8.1.1–8.1.3 — Three Administrator/Staff Nominations (Taken in the Aggregate), First and Final Approval

8.1.1 — John Adams, Interim Assistant Principal for the remainder of the 2026–27 school year, Westbrook Middle School. Dr. Lancia introduced Adams as coming from New Hampshire, where he served as a social studies teacher, assistant principal, co-principal, and principal.

8.1.2 — Eric Campbell, Assistant Director of Special Services (one-year-only position). Dr. Lancia said Campbell is currently a vice president of educational services and is already familiar with a number of Westbrook staff, families, and students.
8.1.3 — Occupational Therapist, Sacarappa School (the item added at the top of the meeting).

Chair Mancuso thanked the school committee members and administrators who served on the interview committees for moving quickly to fill the positions. Both Adams and Campbell were present and briefly thanked the committee for the opportunity.
Approved 4–0, moved by Noreen Poitras, seconded by Allison Brunette.

October 7, 5:00 PM: Finance Committee (Central Office). No school October 9 or 12. October 14, 5:00 PM: Educational Programs Committee (Central Office), followed by the October regular School Committee meeting at 7:00 PM (Room 114). October 21, 5:00 PM: Facilities Committee (Westbrook High School, this month only). October 28, 5:00 PM: Policy Committee (Central Office).
